meta.name: goplaces
meta.description: Query Google Places API (New) via the goplaces CLI for text search, place details, resolve, and reviews. Use for human-friendly place lookup or JSON output for scripts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过命令行查询 Google 地点信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在脚本或终端中快速查询地点详情
copy.tagline_en: Query Google Places info from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly look up place details in scripts or terminal

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询 Google Places API，返回人类可读的地点搜索结果、详情、评论等，或输出 JSON 供脚本使用。
howto.when: 当用户要求查找地点、获取商家详情或评论时触发。

say.text: 帮我找附近评分4以上的咖啡店。
say.note: Claude 会调用搜索命令并返回结果。

say.text: 获取这个地点的详细信息和评论。
say.note: 需要提供地点 ID，Claude 会返回详情和评论。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query the Google Places API to return human-readable place search results, details, reviews, or JSON output for scripts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to find places, get business details, or reviews.

say_en.text: Find coffee shops near me with rating above 4.
say_en.note: Claude will run a search command and return results.

say_en.text: Get details and reviews for this place.
say_en.note: Requires a place ID; Claude returns details and reviews.
